content:
maria-sales: Quick sync — ProspectiveBank wants to run a 2-week eval. Key asks: IdP-initiated SAML with two assertion audiences (app://web and app://batch), SCIM group->role mapping with a custom schema attribute, domain-locked tenant via TXT proof, and RBAC claims in assertions. They also asked how this impacts Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Who can own the POC tech side?

vikram-se: I can take the tech lead. Need to know which IdP (Okta/Azure/ADFS) and whether they require JIT + SCIM delta every 2m vs 5m. Sustained delta at 2m affects rate limits and we'll need to throttle or request Dedicated for heavy syncs.

maria-sales: They're on Okta and want delta sync at ~2m during business hours for ~100-200 users during POC. For production they expect ~10k MAUs. Can Hosted handle the 2m delta bursts for the POC?

oliver-qa: Short answer: Hosted can handle short bursty delta syncs for a 2-week POC if we apply temporary throttling rules and monitor. If they plan sustained high-frequency SCIM (e.g., continuous 2m deltas at scale) we recommend Dedicated. Also we support custom SCIM schemas; please send a sample payload.

maria-sales: Pasting the SCIM group payload they sent:

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group", "urn:custom:params:scim:schemas:extension:1.0:rbac"],
  "displayName": "eng-admins",
  "members": [{"value": "user-123", "display": "jdoe@bank.com"}],
  "urn:custom:params:scim:schemas:extension:1.0:rbac": {"redwoodRole": "admin", "entitlements": ["run_jobs","manage_users"]}
}
```

vikram-se: Good. Implementation notes: we map `urn:custom...:redwoodRole` -> SAML/JWT role claim. For SAML multi-audience assertions, our SP supports multiple AudienceRestriction elements but the IdP metadata must list both audience URIs or we can accept an audience override per SP entry. If they do IdP-initiated flow, confirm the AssertionConsumerService URL(s) and both audience values.

anna-sech: Security asks: we need to confirm KMS integration options for Dedicated/Private, cert rotation cadence, and how SAML cert rollover is handled (support both seamless rollover and manual if IdP can't do overlap). Also request for encryption-at-rest details and SCIM audit log retention policy for Hosted (we keep 90 days by default; can extend for Enterprise). I'll attach the DPA and SOC2 link in the kickoff doc.

deploy-bot: POC environment provisioned: `poc-prospectivebank-redwood-2026`. URL: https://poc.redwood.internal/prospectivebank. Initial admin creds emailed to primary contact.

maria-sales: Thanks. Pricing question from buyer: estimate for a 2-week POC with ~100 active users and then an expected production profile of 10k MAUs with peak inference ~2M tokens/day. They asked whether we bill SCIM operations or if that's included in Hosted usage, and how reserved capacity reduces per-token costs.

oliver-qa: For POC we cover with free credits + usage-based billing. SCIM ops are not billed separately on Hosted; they count as control-plane ops (within free allowance for small customers). For production at 10k MAUs and 2M tokens/day we typically recommend Dedicated with a reserved capacity contract to get predictable latency and lower per-token rates. I'll open a preliminary quote (estimate) and include delta for enterprise observability + extended audit retention.

vikram-se: Action items:
1) maria-sales: share Okta metadata (IdP XML) and SCIM sample from buyer (done)
2) anna-sech: drop cert rollover + DPA/SOC2 links into the thread
3) oliver-qa: draft infra recommendation + finance quote for Dedicated vs Hosted projections
4) vikram-se: prepare config docs for multi-audience SAML and the SCIM custom schema -> role-claim mapping
Target kickoff: Wednesday morning (2 days). :calendar:

maria-sales: :thumbsup: I'll send metadata and schedule kickoff invite. I'll also ask the buyer to add their technical contact in the invite.
